providerInputs.DEEPLSD: gray PNG channel 0 = production Rec.601 luma / 255 as float32 [1,1,H,W], native resolution, no resize; the network's own normalisation only
providerInputs.ELSED: gray PNG channel 0 = production Rec.601 luma, uint8, native resolution; ELSED applies its own Gaussian (sigma 1, 7x7) and Sobel
providerInputs.MOBILESAM: rgb PNG (decoded RGBA, alpha dropped; all frames opaque) uint8 RGB; SamPredictor resizes the long side to 1024 (bilinear, ResizeLongestSide), subtracts pixel mean [123.675,116.28,103.53], divides by std [58.395,57.12,57.375], pads to 1024x1024; masks returned at frame resolution
providerInputs.SOURCE_CV: the production Raster in-process (RGBA as decoded): ink channel min(R,G,B) for masks/bands; Rec.601 luma, box downscale to MAX_WORKING_EDGE, gradient mask for SCV-LINES

rule: every provider sees the same decoded pixels per frame (methodology §3)
